notes: Depth Lighting no longer draws halos or dark bands along a subject's edge and renders the same at fit and at 1:1; Depth Lighting, Fog and Depth Map carry Levels on the depth map with falloff, and every Color Set has a Depth mask. Levels works on the picture as the screen shows it and keeps highlights above white. Linked photographs keep their chains when a section is overridden, Unlink removes overrides, and Reset all edits resets the link. One picker is armed at a time, a Free chip lists the free tier's sections, and a colored dark light shadows in its own color.
